Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units for all exact activity records in assay CHEMBL4649971. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join compound_structures as an inner join, and filter to assay CHEMBL4649971. Keep only rows where standard_value is not null and standard_relation is '='. Do not deduplicate. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
